Intro: I hope you're keeping well. Lately, I've been nostalgic.
I miss walking around the block and basking in the smell of caramelized street sweets. Red, sour hawthorn encased in sugar, bursting on the tongue.
I yearn for the laughter-filled street markets before the stench of violence permeated our senses. Could we ever go back?
Success: I want to walk around the block again someday. I want to turn the corner, and ask a hawker for hawthorn candy, and I want to eat it in the sunshine.
Fail: We all want. Svetka wants to find a cure to Spoilage, but to do so, she relies on people like you turning them in, and stripping them for parts.
Reject: But I will never agree with that "messiah" either.
